scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client conforming to FirebaseStorage via Pyric WebSocket bridge and HTTP byte-route transport. Covers Storage instance & custom gs:// bucket factories, StorageReference hierarchy & URL parsing, async/completion/Result putData & putFile uploads, data/getData & write(toFile:) downloads, tokenized downloadURL, StorageMetadata inspection & patching, object deletion, listAll & cursor-paginated list, observable StorageUploadTask & StorageDownloadTask lifecycle (pause/resume/cancel & observers), and Storage Security Rules enforcement.
